svg.title: Babul-da squeezes his cycle van past Riju and the billboard support.
svg.desc: Babul-da calmly guides the loaded cycle van through a finger-wide gap. Riju presses himself against the steel support as Babul-da observes that the road has been improved by becoming smaller.
